topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and outlines how the lecture will integrate immune system components across the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate recognition of pathogens and tissue damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the innate immune system senses microbial invaders and cellular injury through molecular patterns, receptor localization, and downstream signaling cascades.

topics.label: Inflammatory response propagation and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sentinel cell activation coordinates leukocyte recruitment and adaptive priming, as well as the risks of runaway systemic inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how inflammatory processes are actively and passively terminated, how damaged tissue is repaired, and how persistent stimuli lead to chronic pathology or granuloma containment.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the topic of the next lecture.
